messages.content:
Answer the question. Be concise. Reply with A or B only on the final line.

Six distinct labeled objects have weights [3, 4, 10, 12, 14, 15] in label order. How many unordered subsets of exactly three objects have total weight at most 23 and congruent to 1 modulo 3? Each object is available once; count subsets, not ordered selections.

A. 2
B. 1
